title: dkim.rs: mail-auth parse failure on valid-NNTP RFC-5322-invalid articles generates spurious ParseError
description: verify_dkim_headers in dkim.rs returns a ParseError with 'mail-auth could not parse the article as an RFC 5322 message' whenever AuthenticatedMessage::parse returns None. NNTP articles are RFC 5536 not RFC 5322 — they may have headers that are valid per RFC 5536 but rejected by a strict RFC 5322 parser (e.g. malformed MIME headers, oversized Newsgroups values). An article with no DKIM-Signature headers but non-RFC-5322 formatting would produce a ParseError in the verification store even though there was nothing to verify. Operators will see ParseError rows for every non-RFC-5322-compliant article and may incorrectly conclude their articles are malformed. Fix: distinguish 'parse failed' from 'no DKIM headers' — check for DKIM-Signature presence before attempting full parse, or treat None-parse as 'no DKIM' rather than ParseError when no DKIM-Signature bytes are present.
